/* Statutory rule
   Section 63(c)(6)(B) applies to any individual who is a nonresident alien
   for the taxable year.
*/
section63c6b_applies(Person,Year) :-
    nonresident_alien(Person,Year).

/* Case facts */
nonresident_alien(alice,2017).

/* Verification goal */
:- (  section63c6b_applies(alice,2017)
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.
